title: Samudragupta
exam_points: Prayag Prashasti (Harishena) Ashokan stambh par; Aryavarta (9 raja) aur Dakshinapatha (12 raja) vijay.
Sikke: Ashvamedha, Veena-vadak, Dhanurdhari, Vyaghra-hanta; upadhi 'Kaviraja'.
Sri Lanka ke Meghavarna ko Bodh Gaya mein vihar banane ki anumati.

mcqs.q: Samudragupta ko 'Bharat ka Napoleon' kisne kaha?
